sentence_text: (ii) make a determination with respect to any appeal within twenty days (excepting Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) after the receipt of such appeal.

context.quote: Each agency, upon any request for records made under paragraph (1), (2), or (3) of this subsection, shall—

proposals.allowed_example: An appeal received on a Tuesday is determined on or before the twentieth working day after that Tuesday.
proposals.forbidden_example: An appeal received on a Tuesday is still undetermined on the thirtieth working day after receipt with no extension notice.
